figures.finding: The film workers' agreement covers the director but sets no minimum: its fee table lists Regie as 'freie Vereinbarung' (free agreement); the Austrian Film Institute instead caps the director's fee it recognises in a funded budget, from EUR 36,000 on a EUR 200,000 film to EUR 300,000 on a EUR 10 million film, less 15% for a debut, and up to 30% more for a director with two features made.

value.overpaymentCondition: at least two features already made

figures.applies: Austria; the KV minimum table from 1 July 2026; ÖFI guide rates for films it funds, guidelines valid from 1 January 2026.

figures.finding: A director employed by a theatre of the Bühnenverein of Austria's provinces and cities is one of its Vorstände, whose monthly pay is free agreement but never below the soloists' minimum: EUR 2,177.21 a month from 1 July 2026, 2,226.83 from 1 August 2027 and 2,277.21 from 1 September 2028 (the Zusatz-KV's Sunday, holiday and night supplement left aside, its reach to a Vorstand not read).

value.agreement: Kollektivvertrag für das künstlerische Personal der Theaterunternehmer im Bühnenverein österreichischer Bundesländer & Städte, § 15

figures.applies: Austria, the municipal and provincial theatres of the Bühnenverein (Theatererhalterverband), from 1 July 2026; a guest director on a contract for work isn't employed under it.

sources.said: § 15 Mindestgehalt Die monatlichen Gehälter (Gagen) der Vorstände unterliegen der freien Vereinbarung; sie dürfen jedoch die Mindestgagen der Gruppe der Solisten nicht unterschreiten. … folgende Mindestsätze für die monatlichen Gehälter (Gagen) mit Wirksamkeit ab 1.
